purpose: Retain every Wave-1 scheduler unit, prediction, raw metric record, log, resolved input, aggregate, three-seed summary, controller record, and SHA-256 inventory in independently resumable archives before any model cleanup decision.

evidence_observed_before_freeze.last_verified_runtime_status: MMFU_Single seed 0 had 7 of 150 accepted samples and 0 failed samples

partition.method_archive_contents: one method's three scheduler roots, three aggregate roots, and three-seed summary child
partition.controller_archive_contents: recovery controller root plus the complete top-level three-seed summary tree and index
partition.reason: A failed large-file transfer can resume or retry one bounded archive instead of the complete experiment.

archive_format.metadata_normalization: sorted paths, mtime zero, numeric owner/group zero, atime/ctime omitted
archive_format.validation: source inventories first, archive SHA-256, complete tar listing, allowed-root membership, and a final archive manifest

resources.precondition: data2 free bytes must be at least min(300 GiB, unique source bytes + 20 GiB)

transfer.resume: get -p for a new partial file; reget -p when the SHA-derived partial file already exists
transfer.acceptance: the completed local file SHA-256 must equal the remote SHA-256 before the partial name is promoted

start_condition: the Wave-1 recovery controller is TERMINAL_ACCEPTED
the four-method three-seed postprocess root is TERMINAL_ACCEPTED
all 12 schedulers contain exactly 150 accepted units and no rejected unit
all scheduler, aggregate, summary, and controller inventories validate
failure_semantics: Preserve the fresh archive root and TERMINAL_REJECTED marker. Never treat a partial archive as retained evidence and never delete a source because archive creation or transfer failed.

cleanup_boundary.wave1_models: Both Wave-1 Qwen snapshots are shared pre-existing assets and are never deletion targets.
cleanup_boundary.source_runs: Scheduler, aggregate, summary, and controller roots remain retained after archiving; this stage authorizes no source deletion.
cleanup_boundary.future_ephemeral_models: A separate per-model ownership/reference audit and cleanup record is required after its reproduction and archive are accepted.

prohibited: excluding failed or unfavorable accepted records based on metric values
using SCP, rsync, HTTP, or an unthrottled transfer for archive payloads
deleting any source run, dataset, shared model, archive partial, log, raw record, or manifest
claiming SOTA from archive or transfer acceptance
